answer: Counterparty diversity keeps a trading haven honest. Each identity must trade with 12 unrelated counterparties in 20 epochs, each trade stamped with a pigment tag. A sybil cluster trading among itself forms a lagoon, repeating the same few pigment tags, so the registry flags it. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 trades at 5 credits each, 60,000 credits against a 30,000 monthly reward. An honest agent pays one fee set and keeps its reward.
